certification.gatePolicy: strict Miranda vertical-slice certification is the hard gate; all migrated levels are captured through explicit reporting-only coverage until repeated preview captures meet production thresholds

nonCertifiedScopes.reason: All migrated browser levels are visible through certification.allLevelReporting, but remain reporting-only until each level has repeated preview-run budgets with stable streaming and render cost.

Desktop-high has production certification thresholds, and the Miranda strict slice now passes a current preview capture. Broader desktop-high certification remains limited until at least two repeated preview captures stay within budget without runtime quality dropping below high.
Strict resource profiling is deferred for broad all-level coverage; the first hard gate is certify:performance:strict for the Miranda gameplay slice.
TV certification remains a defined work item; mobile-low is present for comparison but still reporting-only until repeated preview captures establish stable browser budgets.
